messages:
marta: FYI — pulled a perf trace for mixtral-8x7b with AWQ int8. p99 jumps after ~12k tokens. Kernel auto-switch flipped to flash_attn_v3 at large seqs and latency doubled. Also seeing KV GC pauses per-request. AWQ calibration on code prompts shows ~-3.5% EM vs fp16. anyone seen this combo before?

lee: can you paste the perf dump and kernel heuristics table? :eyes:

marta: here are the key snippets from staging run:
```
[perf] seq=512  kernel=triton_gemv    time=9.8ms
[perf] seq=2048 kernel=flash_attn_v3  time=23.4ms
[kv] evict_count=141 cause=kv_full block_ms=14
[awq] calib_set=code-small acc_delta=-3.5%
```

samir: interesting — RoPE scaling mismatch could be amplifying quantization error. mixtral heads use head_dim=64, qwen uses 128; AWQ per-head scales can blow up on outlier heads and affect code tasks. did you try per-head calibration or disabling per-head folding?

marta: quick experiment: forced kernel to triton_gemv for seq=2048 -> time went to 17.9ms (better than 23.4ms but worse than 9.8ms). applying per-head scaling fix restored ~1.8% EM on the code set. KV pauses still visible.

noah: KV GC behavior: current impl runs synchronous compaction on request path when mem>90%. That explains the block_ms spikes. we should flip to async scavenger or incremental compaction and add a small token-based throttle. also batching heuristic: mixing many short seqs with a few long ones causes cache churn and kernel switching; we should bin by seq_len before coalescing.

lee: proposed action items:
- pin kernel whitelist per-model: mixtral prefer triton_gemv up to 4096, flash_attn only above that
- switch KV GC to async scavenger + incremental compaction
- AWQ recalibration with mixed prompt set (code + QA) and run GPTQ baseline for comparison
- add perf regression alert: p99 > 2x baseline triggers rollback

marta: +1. I'll open infra ticket with traces and a small repro harness (will include seq distribution and config). need someone to run the AWQ vs GPTQ sweep.

noah: I can land the KV-GC-async change in staging tonight and monitor p99. assigning to myself.

samir: I'll run AWQ/GPTQ sweep using 40 calibration prompts (20 code snippets, 20 QA). will log EM/BLEU/delta and per-task confusion matrix. plan to try AWQ 8-bit with FP8 fallback on outlier heads.

deploy-bot: staging deployment queued: KV-GC-async (#3245) — ETA 02:00 UTC

marta: great. TL;DR: root causes likely kernel selection + KV GC sync compaction + AWQ calibration set. next: kernel whitelist, async GC, AWQ recalib + GPTQ compare. weekend watch if staging improves. :thumbsup:
